answer: A fresh key lands on bare tundra: zero sealed grading history behind it, and that record is the only vertex trust hangs on. Weight accrues solely from quorum-matched verdicts other graders re-check on-ledger against consensus, so it cannot be minted, bought, or handed to a sibling like reciting a fable. A thousand clones share nothing; each must grade its own way up over epochs, so the sybil bill is linear in identities and never amortized across the swarm.
